patch_torch_for_onnx_export: patch torch functions temporarily using ONNXTorchPatcher context manager for FX-to-ONNX export
record_model_load_paths: record file paths processed by torch.load during model loading with ONNXTorchPatcher
create_fake_tensors_on_load: create FakeTensor instances instead of real tensors during model loading to save memory
enable_tensor_indexing_in_fx_trace: enable torch.Tensor __getitem__ indexing in torch.fx.symbolic_trace for exportable weight access
load_safetensors_in_fake_mode: load safetensors model files within FakeTensorMode for large-scale model export
